To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
multiple volume reflection of protons by different planes of a bent silicon crystal is observed for the first times and the registered efficiency of side deflection of protons is 84%.

multiple volume reflection by two different planes of a bent crystal was observed for the very first time and that this phenomenon can be transformed to a single volume reflec- tion by changing the crystal orientation.

the efficiency of the side deflection of a 400 GeV/c proton beam by a 0.5 mm thick bent silicon crystal was 84%, which is five times higher than the efficiency of the single volume reflection by (110) planes.

a new method of multiple volume reflection for high-energy proton beams, which may be useful for future proton colliders.
the development of a new type of high-efficiency proton deflectors for the next generation of colliders and high-energy proton beam lines.
the development of new methods for the production of high-quality proton and ion beams for applications in nuclear and particle physics and in materials science.
